Question: What is the influence of a hierarchically decomposed B2 + A2 structure on the formation of magnetic vortex states and the origin of coercivity in AlCo(Cr)FeNi high-entropy alloys?. System: AlCoFeNi and AlCo0.5Cr0.5FeNi high-entropy alloys. Processing: Arc melting of Al, Co, Cr, Fe, and Ni pellets in an Ar atmosphere, followed by annealing at 600°C for 15 h in an Ar atmosphere and quenching in water. Test conditions: Bulk magnetization measured at 300 K up to 1 T; Lorentz TEM and off-axis electron holography performed in magnetic-field-free conditions and with applied out-of-plane fields up to 1.5 T; APT conducted at 60 K.
